item.title: RITSEC CTF 2026 - Forensics, Song Inside A Shell
item.description:
Introduction:

Over the weekend, I competed in RITSEC’s CTF. This overall was a tough CTF to someone who has been out of the super technical world for a while now, but between family obligations, and work, I didn’t put more than a few hours into the CTF total.

 

There was one audio forensics challenge that I didn’t get when the event was ongoing, but I revisited it after the event was fully over. This challenge was worth 464 Points, and called “Song Inside A Shell”. For someone who loves forensics, and conveniently is terrible at music production, I found this challenge interesting. A super easy solve if you knew what to do, but more creative then technical.

item.title: I Passed the SANS GSEC in 3 days, here’s how.
item.description:
Introduction

You didn’t read that wrong, I got my SANS GSEC Network, Endpoint, and Cloud in 3 Days, 2 if you count my break from studying, but still listening to the material.

 

My story starts long long ago, and by long long ago, I mean in December of 2023. I had always participated in Cyber Events, and when I was in High School, I discovered CyberStart America (RIP Cyberstart, you will be missed). Cyberstart was an intro-level, 6-month-long CTF that taught the fundamentals of Cybersecurity and Hacking. I fell in love with this event and began taking it more and more seriously, soon, I placed within the top 5 in my state.

I’m Pex.

Breaking web apps, doing forensics, reversing binaries and constantly learning.
